# Launch Screen Assets

Generated with the app icons from shared vector geometry. On macOS, run
`swift scripts/generate_app_icons.swift` from the Reading repository root.

Edit that generator to change the book mark. Launch background light/dark colors
are in the adjacent `LaunchBackground.colorset`; layout is in
`Runner/Base.lproj/LaunchScreen.storyboard`. Do not edit generated PNGs by hand.
